name: DropdownMenu
description: A list of actions or options anchored to a trigger button: action, checkbox and radio items, in groups with labels. Arrow keys move, typeahead jumps, Escape closes. Replaces Dropdown.

livewire.name: dropdown-menu
capabilities: Children: dropdown-menu-item, dropdown-menu-group and dropdown-menu-separator; items renders the same children
wire:click on an item runs from the keyboard too: choosing an item clicks it

props.name: open
props.description: Whether it's open. Livewire binds it with wire:model, Vue with v-model:open. Emitted as data-state on every part.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: The initial state of an uncontrolled menu.

props.name: label
props.a11y: An icon-only trigger needs an aria-label through classes or the slot's text.

props.name: items
props.description: The items as data, rendering the same children as composition: { value, label, icon, shortcut, color: 'error', disabled }, { type: 'checkbox' | 'radio', value, label, checked }, { type: 'separator' } and { type: 'group', label, items }.

props.name: align
props.description: Which of the menu's edges lines up with the trigger's, along the inline axis; start and end follow the text direction. Emitted as data-align.

props.name: surface
props.description: The menu's surface. Emitted as data-surface. Glass falls back to the overlay surface under reduced transparency and in high contrast.

props.name: portal
props.description: Renders the menu at the end of the body, above everything (x-teleport, a React portal, Vue Teleport). Off renders it in place.

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { trigger: '…', item: '…' }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The menu panel, carrying the root class. It is Zag's content part, so it also carries data-part="content" (D-019).

parts.name: content
parts.description: The menu panel: the same element as root.

parts.name: trigger
parts.description: The button that opens the menu.

parts.name: positioner
parts.description: Places the panel against the trigger.

parts.name: itemGroup
parts.description: A group of items, labelled by its label.

parts.name: item
parts.description: An action, checkbox or radio item: role menuitem, menuitemcheckbox or menuitemradio.

parts.name: shortcut
parts.description: An item's keyboard shortcut, shown at the end.

parts.name: itemIndicator
parts.description: The check on a checkbox or radio item, shown while it's checked.

events.name: open-change
events.description: The menu opened or closed itself: the trigger, Escape, an outside click or a choice. Setting open doesn't fire it.

events.name: select
events.description: An action item was chosen, by click or Enter. The payload is its value.

events.name: checked-change
events.description: A checkbox or radio item was chosen. Its checked state stays the owner's to set.

keyboard.action: On the trigger, opens the menu on the first item.
On the trigger, opens the menu on the last item.
Move to the next or previous item, skipping disabled ones.
Move to the first or last item.
Typeahead: moves to the next item whose label starts with the typed text.
Chooses the item; a checkbox or radio item toggles.
Closes the menu and returns focus to the trigger.
Closes the menu and moves on.

requirements: role=menu with menuitem, menuitemcheckbox and menuitemradio items; checked items set aria-checked.
The trigger sets aria-haspopup=menu, aria-expanded and aria-controls.
Focus moves into the menu on open and returns to the trigger when it closes.
Disabled items set aria-disabled and are skipped by the arrow keys.
Groups are labelled by their label with aria-labelledby.
The highlighted item shows the hover tint and the focus ring.
Danger items (color error) use --apui-color-error-text, 4.5:1 on the overlay surface; put them last, after a separator.
The panel opens below the trigger at its start edge and mirrors in RTL; it flips when there's no room.
Every part keeps a stable, server-rendered id in Livewire and items carry wire:key (D-015).
